role: Exception hierarchy for Layer 2 perception pipeline failures
detail: Defines a four-level exception hierarchy rooted in PerceptionError (inherits CoBeingError). CaptureError signals camera/frame acquisition failures (device unavailable, read() returns False, buffer overflow). DetectionError covers YOLO model failures (file corruption, malformed output, runtime crashes). TrackingError indicates multi-object tracker structural failures (IOU matrix computation errors, invalid state transitions, inconsistent internal state). PersistenceCheckError handles Layer 3 persistence-check read interface failures (via CANON A.5) and is recoverable. All route through PerceptionError base class for granular exception catching by callers.
gotchas: None identified; PersistenceCheckError explicitly marked as recoverable (treat as cache miss); single dropped frames handled silently (not a CaptureError); low-confidence detections and routine track transitions are not errors by design.
